name: Gazebo Sim (gz-sim)
problems: mixed Debian and from-source installations can cause gz-tools command line tools to malfunction unless GZ_CONFIG_PATH is set correctly
naming transition from 'Ignition' to 'Gazebo' (2022 trademark issue) still causes confusion with older documentation and packages referencing the previous name
source_notes: Open-source robotics simulator providing physics, rendering, and sensor models. Successor to Gazebo Classic, derived from over 16 years of development history. Maintained by Open Robotics.
